units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:5:4">Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ</cite> <he>וקַסְמָהּ בידיה וכ׳</he> he chipped it (their argument) with his hand, i.e. made a motion with his hand to indicate his dissent (and said) &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 21:26">Targ. Ez. XXI, 26</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 18:10">Targ. Deut. XVIII, 10</cite> <he>קָסֵים</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <cite ref="S01666"><he>קָסֵם</he></cite>, incorr. <cite ref="S00476"><he>קוֹסֵם</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 68b:2">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>חזי … קָסֵים אחיך</he> saw a diviner who was divining, and laughed (at him).
<cite ref="Gittin 68b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>לִקְסוֹם … תותיה</he> let him divine what is under him.
